test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_chain_derived ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() AS SELECT repeat('p', 100) || 'a' || toString(number % 100) AS s1, repeat('p', 100) || 'b' || toString(number % 100) AS s2, repeat('p', 100) || 'c' || toString(number % 100) AS s3, repeat('p', 100) || 'd' || toString(number % 100) AS s4, if(number % 100 = 0, 'a', 'z') || repeat('q', 200) || toString(number) AS b, leftPad(toString(number % 100000), 8, '0') AS x, number AS k FROM numbers_mt(10000000)
CREATE TABLE t_chain_derived_join ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() AS SELECT number AS k, number - (number % 2) AS v FROM numbers_mt(10000000)
test.fill_query: OPTIMIZE TABLE t_chain_derived FINAL SETTINGS optimize_throw_if_noop = 1
OPTIMIZE TABLE t_chain_derived_join FINAL SETTINGS optimize_throw_if_noop = 1

SELECT throwIf(count() != 2, 'and_compare_chain_derived: expected 1 active part per table') FROM system.parts WHERE database = currentDatabase() AND table IN ('t_chain_derived', 't_chain_derived_join') AND active
test.query: SELECT count() FROM t_chain_derived WHERE s1 < s2 AND s2 < s3 AND s3 < s4 AND s4 < repeat('p', 100) || 'z'
SELECT count() FROM t_chain_derived WHERE hex(sipHash64(repeat(x, 200))) < b AND b < 'z'
SELECT count() FROM t_chain_derived_join AS l INNER JOIN t_chain_derived AS r ON l.k = r.k WHERE l.v < r.k AND 8000000 < l.v
SELECT count() FROM t_chain_derived AS l INNER JOIN t_chain_derived_join AS r ON l.k = r.k WHERE l.s1 < l.s2 AND l.s2 < l.s3 AND l.s3 < l.s4 AND l.s4 < repeat('p', 100) || 'd2'
